name: nidus
notes: Greenfield repo: ticket #2 (walking skeleton) creates the toolchain; until it merges, checks.unit and checks.lint do not exist and only #2 is eligible anyway.
The fleet works on `master` directly: branch from it, open PRs against it, merge into it. Netlify production deploys from master only once ticket #14 lands.

Every schema change is a committed migration under supabase/migrations/ applied to the LOCAL Supabase stack (`supabase start`). There is no hosted project until ticket #14; never create one from an IC.
Tests act as a real principal through the Supabase JS client against the local stack; Google's HTTP API is the only fake. Never mock the database.
Use CONTEXT.md vocabulary in code, tests and PR text. Respect docs/adr/0001 (Supabase, no custom backend) and 0002 (read-only mirror, never write to Google).
House style: no em-dashes in user-facing copy.
Never use git stash in any form; commit work-in-progress to your own branch.
Never switch branches in E:\nidus itself; fleet sessions live in .claude/worktrees/.
